_meta.purpose: Provider freshness obligations over existing derived observations; no new store.
_meta.cadence_derivation: 60s is the smallest current collector poll: AW60, NWS600, AirNow1800. Timer is derived from this policy.
_meta.ambient_derivation: Measured maximum next valid outdoor arrival minus previous retained outdoor observation timestamp = 144.304253s over188 contiguous valid intervals after operator-reported06:00EST breaker restoration through16:21:06.866765UTC. Reset on every failed/non-outdoor return (126excluded in window); no age-based filter. Add only the acquisition owner REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S=15s for request allowance beyond the empirical interval: 159.304253s. This replaces the arrival-lag-plus-assumed-poll fit; method/full metadata in docs/plans/provider-health-intervals.*. Ambient remains unactivated pending receiving/native qualification.
_meta.nws_derivation: Existing NWS_MAX_OBSERVATION_AGE_S7200 admission bound + NWS_POLL_S600 + owner REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S15 =7815s.
_meta.airnow_derivation: AirNow hourly timestamp granularity3600s + about3600s publication lag + AIRNOW_POLL_S1800 + contract timeout15 =9015s. https://airnow-blue.app.cloud.gov/about-the-data/ and https://docs.airnowapi.org/faq, checked2026-11-19.
_meta.provisional: All bounds are provisional: settle the distribution of successful observation ages and false alerts under loaded, healthy collection. Ambient fit is finite current-day new arrivals; AirNow publication lag is approximate, not an SLA. No outage is relabelled healthy to fit these bounds.
_meta.timezone: AirNow location is Satellite Beach; America/New_York resolves its observed EST/EDT metadata, which must agree. Ambient ts is UTC by its projector; NWS ts carries its own offset.

lanes.name: ambient_outdoor
lanes.query: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts FROM outdoor WHERE {outdoor_presence}

lanes.name: nws
lanes.query: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts FROM nws_weather

lanes.name: airnow
